hero.heading: SVANDA, the karaoke jukebox
hero.title: Built from scratch.
hero.subtitle: Our own cabinet, our own app, our own karaoke versions of every song.

karaoke.title: Sing it the way it sounds on the radio.
karaoke.body: Every song in the library has its own karaoke version: vocals out, music in full quality. Lyrics run on a TV or monitor connected to the jukebox, so the whole room can follow along.

jukebox.title: Pick a song and play!
jukebox.body: A song queue for the whole night, controlled from the display. Our own cabinet, our own app, no subscription.

banner.title: Cookies and analytics
banner.description: We use only the storage the website needs to work, plus cookieless visitor analytics that you can switch off. Marketing stays off unless you allow it.

preferences.title: Cookie settings
preferences.description: Choose which categories the website may use. You can change your choice at any time through Cookie settings in the website footer.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.description: Remember your settings, such as the appearance, the language and this choice. The website cannot work without them, so they are always on.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Cookieless visit measurement with our own Umami instance. It stores nothing on your device and helps us improve the website.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: We use no marketing cookies at the moment. If we add any, they will load only with your consent.

home.title: SVANDA: the karaoke jukebox built from scratch
